causal_claims: All five scored, so this version passes hidden execution and CSV validation.
Epoch continuation alone yields small gains through epoch 8 and no gain at epoch 10 on the public slice.
The 0.304 gap to a multi-model earlier OSS-copy entry does not isolate DINOv3-versus-DINOv2 backbone quality.
Raw decimal sigmoid values are valid; per-target monotone formatting/calibration cannot change ROC AUC ranking.
Weak-label sparsity, domain mismatch, architecture capacity and unmeasured hidden-run fallback behavior are plausible hypotheses, not proven causes.
Two rare targets alone cannot explain the 0.304 gap: improving any two AUCs from 0 to 1 raises a 12-target mean by at most 0.167.
metric: public Kaggle mean ROC AUC over 12 targets
recommended_followups: If Kaggle permits access to the hidden generated CSV or aggregate notebook receipt, check output coverage, fallback rates and per-target prediction diversity without accessing hidden labels.
Confirm per-target data and prediction polarity against the accepted release and fixed internal gold diagnostic without tuning on the gold set.
Compare the OSS ensemble and our DINOv3 branch on a common leak-safe internal validation protocol, reviewing third-party licensing and exact MRI-only inference.
Prioritize a bounded last-block or LoRA encoder adaptation and higher-resolution target localization with three-fold OOF evaluation; compare to a fixed ensemble before spending another submission.
score_rounding: API exposes three decimals; differences of 0.001-0.003 may be fragile
